findings.title: spec-docs-path resolved without create semantics
findings.disposition_rationale: resolveDocsPath picks the directory from config or the existence of docs/ and doc/ before it creates anything, so create only adds a mkdir; the command creates the same directory lazily at write time and writes nothing on needs-judgement
